This is a senior-level systems engineering role on Cloudflare's Application Security team, working on their security product portfolio — WAF, Page Shield, Web Asset Management, and API Shield — at very large scale. The core stack is Go and Rust, with devops tooling like Kubernetes, Salt, Kafka, and Systemd, running on Linux/Unix in distributed systems. The work involves designing and reviewing systems, writing and reviewing code, and operating the services in production including on-call rotation.
